beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An elegant explanation cannot rescue a code patch that fails its tests.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Judgment Engines asks how automated evaluators can earn authority over decisions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its central claim is that reliable judgment requires an engineered procedure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book connects explicit standards, checked evidence, and the consequences of a verdict.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers learn to examine the evaluator before trusting what its scores permit.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A flat average can let excellent presentation compensate for a critical failure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed alternative gives some criteria explicit dependencies or vetoes.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: In the patch example, a failed test keeps release blocked.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Clarity can still be assessed without cancelling that functional failure.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The standard becomes an inspectable evaluation program, rather than a list of adjectives.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The code chapters insist on running available checks before asking for opinions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Tests provide behavioral evidence, but an existing suite can miss an important requirement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Semantic review compares the change with its intended purpose and looks for missing cases.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: These roles complement each other without turning the model into a pretend test runner.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same division carries into evidence checking across the wider book.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The evaluator itself then needs tests designed to expose misleading shortcuts.
